description: This file defines a React custom hook `useSupabaseAuth` that interfaces with an authentication store (`useAuthStore`) to manage and access Supabase authentication state and actions within a React application. It initializes auth state, provides access to auth data, and exposes methods for sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, password reset, and password update, along with computed values like `siteUrl`.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth()
methods.description: React hook for accessing and managing Supabase authentication via Zustand store, initializing auth state if not yet initialized.
